fields.label: Enable Verification Redirect
fields.description: When enabled, invoice QR codes point to the ERP verification page, which checks the invoice’s eTIMS submission status and redirects to the official eTIMS verification URL when available. When disabled, QR codes point directly to the eTIMS verification URL.

fields.label: Submission Timeframe
fields.description: Defines the allowed period for entries to be sent to eTIMS, such as invoices and purchases, from the current time. For example, if set to 4 days, entries can only be sent within the last 4 days.

fields.label: Max Sales Submission Attempts
fields.description: Maximum attempts allowed to resubmit failed sales invoices before restrictions apply.

fields.label: Max Purchase Submission Attempts
fields.description: Maximum attempts allowed to resubmit failed purchase invoices before restrictions apply.

fields.label: Max Stock Submission Attempts
fields.description: Maximum attempts allowed to resubmit failed stock operations before restrictions apply.
